name: midnight-box
description: Self-hosted party jukebox: guests scan a QR code to search, queue and vote on songs played through the host's Spotify.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:demo -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
